messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: useR 2016 tutorial?
parts:
The main R conference is at Stanford next summer

http://user2016.org/

and is soliciting proposals by January 6 for 3-hour tutorials. Do we want to submit one for rstan(arm) and / or do something else Stan-related in Silicon Valley in conjunction with the conference?

Ben

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] useR 2016 tutorial?
parts:
Is anyone planning on going anyway? It's the kind of thing
we can pay for out of the Sloan foundation funding --- looks like
this one we pay for, probably including have to register for
the conference itself. Here's the very limited call:

We invite all members of the R community to submit proposals
for three hour tutorials on relevant, R topics. Proposals
should include a brief description of the tutorial including
its goals, a detailed outline, a justification for the
importance of the tutorial, a description of the intended
audience and an indication of the required background knowledge
of the attendees. To be considered, proposals must be received
at useR...@R-project.org before midnight PST, January 10, 2016.
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

We could also submit a talk --- it looks pretty open-ended.

- Bob

If we are doing it, I could contact those Google people I taught for before, and see if they might be interested in a Stan course.
Also, should we be organizing an annual Stan conference?
